# GLAD loader

This directory contains the generated OpenGL 3.3 Core loader used by Fallen Signal.

Generated with [GLAD](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad) **v2.0.8** using:

```text
glad --reproducible --api gl:core=3.3 --extensions '' c --loader
```

The generated loader carries the SPDX identifier `(WTFPL OR CC0-1.0) AND Apache-2.0`; see `LICENSE` and the notices embedded in the generated files. The generated source is committed so configuring the game does **not** require Python or a GLAD installation.
